description: This file defines the NoteViewHolder class, a RecyclerView.ViewHolder implementation for displaying notes in a list, including handling UI updates for note content, tags, attachments, and state indicators.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder for displaying note items, managing UI components such as title, content, tags, attachments, and state indicators, with methods for binding data and updating UI based on note properties.

methods.name: updateBackgroundColor
methods.description: Updates the background color of the note item based on the NoteColor.

methods.name: updateTags
methods.description: Updates the display of tags associated with the note, reusing views to optimize performance.

methods.name: updateIndicatorIcons
methods.description: Sets visibility of various indicator icons based on note properties and search mode.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the note's title in the UI, hiding the title view if empty.

methods.name: setTextContent
methods.description: Displays the note's content, rendering markdown if enabled, or plain text otherwise.

methods.name: setTasks
methods.description: Displays the list of tasks if the note is a list type, with a limit and 'more' indicator.

methods.name: setupAttachments
methods.description: Prepares and displays attachments, showing a 'more' indicator if necessary.

methods.name: runPayloads
methods.description: Updates specific parts of the UI based on a set of payloads indicating what changed.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Note object to the ViewHolder, updating all UI components accordingly.

methods.name: onSelectedStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates the visual state of the item when selected or deselected.
